question: Where is the closest hotel in relation to White Memorial Foundation, Litchfield, CT?
sql: SELECT poi_name, addr_city, addr_state, ST_Distance( P.geometry::geography, (SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%White Memorial Foundation%' LIMIT 1)::geography ) AS distance_meters FROM pois AS P WHERE P.tourism = 'hotel' AND P.addr_city ILIKE '%Litchfield%' AND P.addr_state ILIKE '%CT%' ORDER BY distance_meters ASC LIMIT 1;
